purpose: Specify one bounded origin-only readiness test for a new endpoint; preserve original scientific Tasks 6-8 and H1-H6.
policy_provenance: All frame, caps, endpoint operationalizations and pass/stop rules below are project design choices, not provider guarantees or regulatory qualification.

preservation.b0: stopped; no expansion of failed branch; 17/32 January coverage below frozen 90% workload rule
preservation.harder_t6: completed bounded source-prioritization development; not clinical training/reference truth
preservation.old_clinical_labels: not read or parsed by this design authoring
preservation.historical_cases: remain exposed development; no new query or label rescue
preservation.original_objectives: H1-H6 and Tasks6-8 preserved; this endpoint is a separately named prospective operationalization

endpoint.forecast: Reported disposition of the authentic origin-fixed designated efficacy decision; not causal benefit, phase advancement, registration, reporting, dosing or individual-target efficacy.
endpoint.applicability: Each field is supported or explicitly not_applicable with original-source justification; unsupported mandatory applicable field prevents joint-ready.
endpoint.material_rule_policy: Rule must exist and be available by F; later consistent detail is clarification only. Material changes to endpoint/population/threshold/multiplicity/analysis retain original assessment or unknown_changed; amended-rule assessment is separate diagnostic.
endpoint.failure_rule: Explicit nonattainment of authentic definitive rule; futility only if included in frozen rule and definitive. No default p<0.05, rounded-boundary reconstruction, favorable endpoint choice or secondary/subgroup substitution.
endpoint.origin_risk: Eligible only with positive source-supported evidence that the same designated decision has not occurred by F; absence of a report is insufficient.

frame.source: ClinicalTrials.gov v2 current-state capture, not a historical archive
frame.calendar_rule: Freeze explicit UTC dates before acquisition; inclusive date interval spans 30 calendar dates and ends before R; do not move it after seeing counts/yield.
frame.enumeration: Enumerate ALL records first posted in the interval, without clinical/document/results filters; local screen uses retained allowed origin fields.
frame.phase_rule: Exact array set, order-insensitive, no extra phase; PHASE1+PHASE2 and standalone PHASE3 excluded. PHASE2_PHASE3 is not an accepted enum.
frame.screen_algorithm: For required criteria, any known disqualifying criterion => ineligible, with every observed missing/conflict retained; otherwise any missing/conflict/date ambiguity => screen_unknown; otherwise eligible. Source date conflict/out-of-interval payload stops frame integrity rather than silently excluding.
frame.unknowns: Retain missing/ambiguous required values, identity/program ambiguity and origin-risk unknown separately; do not treat as negatives or silently eligible.
frame.sampling_pool: eligible plus screen_unknown after exposure exclusions; unknown sample members remain unknown if unresolved; no source availability filter
frame.algorithm: After complete frame and all-member screening/exposure seal, sort by SHA256(UTF8(protocol_sha256 + canonical_uppercase_NCTId)), tie-break canonical NCTId; take first min(12,pool_count). Protocol digest is of sealed bytes before dispatch. Retain every selected record regardless of package yield.
frame.inference: Exposed source-defined readiness workload audit; descriptive counts only, no clinical power/population yield CI/independent-event claim.

exposure_policy.inventory_rule: Before dispatch seal additional exposed identities from retained ID/membership manifests only, without reading old outcome labels. Exclude them from proposed readiness pool and future untouched claim; retain all excluded denominators. This inventory is not yet complete.

frame.coverage_limit: Source-defined current latest-version retrieval over a posted-date interval, not point-in-time snapshot or complete clinical population. Records missing or ambiguous posting dates outside the query-returned frame cannot be claimed enumerated; report this source-coverage limitation. Returned missing/inconsistent dates stop complete-frame integrity.

blockers: Exact-review future date filter semantics, query/request bytes and response allowlist against pinned archived OpenAPI/metadata/search areas and schema-derived source-check; frozen leaf projection alone is not request acceptance.
Seal explicit R and interval dates; offline-test pagination, empty-page-with-token, count, schema, byte and outcome-field guards.

New bounded list/query transport and per-ID design/document product contract required: existing exact-ID transport rejects query strings; old document helper combined-protocol/SAP contract must not be weakened.
Freeze complete exposure inventory and outcome-quarantine packet sanitization before dispatch.
request_contract.sort_constraint: NCTId sort unsupported; API supports date/numeric sorting with maximum two fields. Local digest/NCT order only after full enumeration.
request_contract.pagination: countTotal first page; preserve sealed parameters on subsequent pages except documented paging/count changes. Continue while token exists even if studies empty. Reconcile totalCount, unique IDs and terminal token; exact response guard required.
request_contract.per_id_origin_packet: Frozen leaf names/paths above. Actual exact per-ID URL/request bytes and sanitization guard remain blocked; free text can contain outcomes and needs source-steward quarantine. Source listing cannot itself establish origin risk or authentic decision rule.
request_contract.accidental_outcome_policy: Quarantine unsanitized original evaluator-only; independent source steward prepares allowed packet without selection use. Record exposure, hold affected origin/predictor qualification pending frozen isolation review; no replacement. If boundary violation cannot be contained, stop batch.
request_contract.metadata_limit: Schema/version access success is not study-endpoint access, authentic-original-document proof, complete frame, history reconstruction or clinical qualification.
request_contract.capture_drift: Check version/dataTimestamp before and after; mismatch stops. Equal timestamp is necessary diagnostic only, never proof of atomic snapshot isolation.
request_contract.projection_status: Leaf field names and paths frozen against archived schema; exact query/request bytes/server acceptance remain blocked; no runnable manifest.

cap_handling: Stop on incomplete enumeration, count above500, byte/time/attempt bound, identity/hash/schema/boundary violation, missing token chain, duplicate/conflicting IDs, unexpected result content or inconsistent capture. No truncation, window shift, automatic retry or outcome-informed replacement. Zero complete packages stops route; new acquisition requires newly sealed executable version satisfying technical gates within existing authorization retaining failures.

hierarchy: Exact NCT-bound retained registry listing and original issuer/registry-hosted authentic protocol/SAP with trial/sponsor/version bridge
Authenticated issuer amendment history within the same bounded packet if present
document_selection.selection: Choose latest applicable version actually captured before eventual F with authentic material-rule/version bridge; select combined protocol+SAP as one when available, otherwise exact protocol and SAP as two. Ties/conflicting versions or requirements beyond two PDFs => insufficient_under_cap, not easiest-source substitution. No search fallback or extra clarification request under v0.1.
document_selection.absence_rule: Not listed is not_listed_in_observed_projection, not proof no protocol/SAP exists; access failure and absent listing remain distinct.

date_interval_shape.basis: Exact date or justified bounds only; do not invent dates/time zones or intersect different events.

evidence_state_schema.numeric_efficacy_label: null during all readiness work. Later 1 only success plus every applicable scope/rule/prespecification/origin-risk/source/temporal gate; 0 only explicit qualifying definitive failure with same gates; otherwise null.
evidence_state_schema.joint_ready_rule: At readiness R only: every applicable scope/authenticity/rule/prespecification/version/public-capture item supported with locators and no conflict; positive evidence of no designated decision by R is required. This is provisional readiness at R, not eligibility at future F. Outcome occurrence/polarity remain not_assessed. Requalify unchanged material rules and origin risk at actual future F before prediction launch; never require future outcomes before freeze.

reference.claim: Source-linked documentary decision extraction, not independent therapeutic truth
reference.method: Two isolated source-only extractions with exact citations; seal both before reconciler visibility; reconciler checks every mandatory field against originals, does not majority-vote. No extra discovery under this cap; unresolved conflict remains unknown.
reference.agent_agreement: Reproducibility only; shared model/source bias disclosed, no clinical gold standard by agreement.

windows.rule: Choose F genuinely future only after launch prerequisites; freeze actual rule, origin-risk, horizon and separate justified ascertainment allowance before predictions/outcomes. Formal designated decision occurrence uses whole supported interval in (F,H]; disclosure is only a bound. Late-public in-window evidence outside deadline is sensitivity only; no primary deadline extension.

statistics.pilot_inference: Descriptive all-frame and selected-record counts; record/program/component counts separate; no event prevalence/power inference.
statistics.original_h1: Paired clinical AUROC improvement versus Virtual Biotech; one-sided p<0.05; Brier co-primary; smallest effect of interest0.05.
statistics.original_h2: Clinical superiority versus both genetics-only and time-masked Open Targets; better claim requires H1 and H2.
unresolved: Reconcile original one-sided H1 with retained proxy two-sided absolute-AUROC simulation.
Define Brier co-primary success criterion and calibration precision.
Freeze H1/H2 co-primary and secondary multiplicity.
Resolve indication-only bootstrap versus product/target cross-indication dependencies.
Justify clinical event/prevalence, label error, missingness, paired correlation, cluster size and abstention scenarios; qualify separate training sample.

planning_target.interpretation: Project choice under justified conservative clinical scenarios, not proxy count evidence.

statistics.dependency_plan: Freeze primary trial/regimen/product components plus target/sponsor/indication sensitivity graphs before outcomes; paired resampling of independent components only where justified; component count is not an invented effective N.
statistics.simulation: Specify and validate actual component-respecting clinical inference and null type-I behavior separately from power, with Monte Carlo uncertainty and invalid replicates; not run by this document.
statistics.missingness: Keep all-member and evaluable denominators, competing stops and unknowns. Conditional decision-complete performance named as conditional. Whole-frame binary efficacy needs explicit estimand/identification assumptions; no automatic censoring/IPCW/imputation. Binary-compatible equal-weight positive proportion bounds positive/N to (positive+unknown)/N are identification bounds, not performance bounds/CIs; competing events require own estimand.

requirements: Protocol/schema/caps/exposure policy present
Parent hash and link validation
Independent design reviews reconciled; blockers honestly retained
No activation or old-study mutation
design_accepted.effect: Internal design acceptance only; zero members, queries, labels or predictions.

requirements: Separately sealed executable bounded source request satisfying existing user-authorized scope and technical gates
Seal R and interval dates
Exact request/projection/response review against archived schema; offline guards
New transport/product contract compatibility and safety review
Exposure inventory and outcome quarantine sealed
Protocol bytes/digest sealed before membership
readiness_acquisition.effect: Only complete bounded enumeration, deterministic max12 and origin-only packet qualification; no fitting/prediction/followup.

disposition.stop: Any unresolved integrity/boundary failure or incomplete capped frame; zero joint_ready packages after fixed audit stops route.
disposition.revise: At least one joint_ready plus partial/conflicted packages: name missing element; preserve all failures. Any further acquisition requires newly sealed version and technical gates within existing authorization.
disposition.route_exists_only: At least1 fully evidenced joint_ready package, complete denominators and zero unresolved integrity/boundary violations; not clinical sufficiency or automatic scaling.

readiness_acquisition.disposition_precedence: stop > revise > route_exists_only. Incomplete frame/integrity failure stops regardless of package count; zero joint_ready stops even when partial packages exist. With at least one joint_ready and no stop condition, any partial/conflicted package produces revise with route existence reported descriptively; route_exists_only disposition requires no unresolved revision condition.

requirements: Claim-specific endpoint/unit bridge to original target-indication objectives
Qualified earlier clinical training/calibration labels and scientific references
Origin-eligible features and leakage-safe component-separated training/calibration/test
Qualified fitted/calibrated scorer; no probabilities from uncalibrated ranking
Matched comparator model/data/budget/access recipe pinned
Complete source-frame design and attainable independent documentary reference route
Justified planned event/precision/power and training adequacy, Brier criterion, sidedness and multiplicity resolved
F genuinely future; membership/origin-risk/material rule/windows frozen
All immutable model weights, revision hashes, prompts, tools, source ancestry, selection/aggregation/abstention and score recipes pinned
Predictions/abstentions sealed before followup; exposure disclosed
Public registration decision handled separately if chosen
Requalify origin risk and unchanged authentic material rule at actual F; readiness-R qualification cannot certify a later origin.
prospective_prediction_launch.not_required: Realized future test outcomes; those cannot precede genuinely prospective prediction freeze.
prospective_prediction_launch.effect: Prospective predictions and later bounded followup only after all scientific and technical gates pass within existing authorized scope; this non-dispatch design does not activate them.

requirements: Prespecified ascertainment ended or frozen interim rule applies
Qualified realized decision references and timing; all unknowns/competing events retained
Paired frozen predictions and realized adequate information assessed
Frozen statistical method valid for dependence/missingness; sensitivity and scope limits reported
No retrospective primary-window/rule/member replacement
later_analysis_release.effect: Only endpoint-scoped inferential claims supported by realized data; does not automatically complete H3-H6/T2-T5.

remaining_scientific_gates.task6_H1_H2: Qualified clinical labels/features/scorer/reference, fair comparator and sized clinical evaluation
remaining_scientific_gates.H3: Dated publication count and prespecified popularity-adjusted analysis
remaining_scientific_gates.H4: Validated chronology-eligible regional genetics features and ablation
remaining_scientific_gates.task7_H5_T6: Claim-specific independent therapeutic references, blinded qualified assessment and heldout design; expert preference cannot be agent preference without amendment
remaining_scientific_gates.task8_T2: Qualified T1-linked matched outcomes with same-indication and dependency controls
remaining_scientific_gates.task8_T3: All-gene candidate universe, dated evidence, entrant ascertainment and positive-unlabeled interpretation
remaining_scientific_gates.task8_T5: Scope/causal-qualified safety stops and organ classes with adequate events
remaining_scientific_gates.H6: Original analysis matrix/features/covariates, mappings, clustering and out-of-time reconstruction

execution_policy: Root continues safe technical preparation and validation autonomously under existing user authorization; source dispatch remains technically blocked while exact request/guards are null or unqualified. No newly invented human approval gate. Actual missing file/credential/permission issues are escalated only when established. Documentary acceptance cannot itself activate clinical work.
